notes: DrandBeacon permissionlessly verifies drand evmnet BLS signatures on BN254 and has no constructor arguments. GammaGame uses the specified PoolManager and IMD addresses, the deployed DrandBeacon and $owner as its configurator. Players buy energies with IMD, burning the GAMMA bought, and play four machines with 10/30/60/90% fail rates. The fixed 800M GAMMA Reserve releases tranches every 10 minutes; survivors split Shares and failures split the evening Harvest. Claim fees fall from 80% to 10% over 24 hours from the day's end and split among burning, other unclaimed holders and Harvest. Randomness comes only from drand, with no block-data fallback or backend signer; a delayed round delays settlement and remains provable later. Hook fees are accepted only in GAMMA, with no IMD fee accumulation or conversion. GammaGame has no owner, mint or withdraw. It deploys uninitialized; the configurator can initialize it once with a funded Reserve and a pool key whose hook reports binding to this game and pool. Initialization is outside this manifest. This manifest deploys only DrandBeacon and GammaGame, in that order, from the accepted source.
